title: Bergeralm Adventure World Steinach am Brenner
name: Bergeralm Adventure World Steinach am Brenner
kurzbeschreibung: The Bärenbachl adventure realm on the Bergeralm in Steinach: water play park at 1,600 m in the Wipptal featuring a raft pond, tree house, and nature trail.
beschreibung:
Overview

The family-friendly Freizeit- und Erlebniswelt Bergeralm is nestled at the mid-station of the Bergeralmbahn high above the market town of Steinach am Brenner in the Tyrolean Wipptal (Innsbruck-Land district) at an altitude of around 1,600 meters. Located just 25 kilometers south of Innsbruck along the Brenner corridor, this mountain arena offers a captivating blend of pristine alpine scenery, rushing mountain brooks, and naturally designed adventure playgrounds against the scenic backdrop of the Stubai and Tux Alps.

Bärenbachl, Water Play & Nature Trail

The centerpiece at the mid-station is the popular Bärenbachl-Wassererlebnis: along a babbling natural mountain stream, children can build dams at interactive water stations, turn water wheels, sculpt mud castles, and pull themselves across an idyllic mountain lake on handcrafted wooden rafts. An extensive forest educational trail winds through the fragrant mountain woods leading to impressive tree houses, suspension bridges, and scenic viewing platforms. Informative display boards playfully share insights into the native wildlife of the Wipptal – from brown bears and chamois to woodpeckers and alpine newts. For hikers, the modern chairlifts starting from the mid-station open up panoramic high-altitude trails leading to the Nösslachjoch (2,231 m) with far-reaching vistas extending to the Dolomites.

Visit & Getting There

The Bergeralmbahn and the Bärenbachl adventure park are open daily during the summer season from early June to mid-October from 09:00 to 16:30. Entry to the Bärenbachl water park is included free of charge with the cable car ticket. Summer lift fares to the mid-station (as of the 2025/2026 season): round trip adults approx. €18.50, seniors approx. €16.50, children (6 to 15 years) approx. €10.00, small children free. Holders of the regional Wipptal guest card receive discounts. Getting there by car: Via the Brenner motorway A13 (exit Matrei-Steinach) or the B182 to Steinach, parking spaces are available directly at the valley station (free of charge). By public transport: ÖBB S-Bahn (line S3) to Steinach am Brenner station, followed by an easy eight-minute walk to the cable car.

Tips

The mid-station and the entire Bärenbachl area are stroller-friendly and largely barrier-free; a change of dry clothes and towels for young water enthusiasts is strongly recommended. Located right by the lake, the Panoramarestaurant Bergeralm with its large sun terrace welcomes guests to savor traditional Tyrolean alpine specialties.
